items.title: 習主席の訪米に抗議デモ、ワシントンで国賓待遇の米中首脳会談
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
中国の習近平国家主席の訪米に抗議するデモが24日、米ワシントンの中国大使館前とホワイトハウス前で行われた。デモの参加者らは中国大使館とホワイトハウスの前に集まり、習主席を批判するプラカードや写真を掲げ、激しく抗議する様子も見られた。

習主席は23日、3日間の日程でワシントンに到着。24日にはホワイトハウスで豪華な国賓待遇を受け、トランプ米大統領と首脳会談を行った。ただ、儀礼的な演出は盛大だった一方で、具体的な成果は乏しく、人工知能（AI）、貿易、台湾、イランとの戦争といった懸案事項について、目立った進展はなかったとみられる。

items.title: インタビュー：ラピダス、量産成功なら将来は米生産も＝自民半導体議連会長
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kentaro Okasaka　Sam Nussey

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 自民党の半導体戦略推進議員連盟の山際大志郎会長（元経済財政相）は、政府が支援し先端半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区）
items.body:
Kentaro Okasaka　Sam Nussey

[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 自民党の半導体戦略推進議員連盟の山際大志郎会長（元経済財政相）は、政府が支援し先端半導体の量産を目指すラピダス（東京都千代田区） について「現段階では奇跡的にオンスケジュールで進んでいる」と評価した。量産が実現すれば、世界的な供給不足を追い風に顧客は確保でき「ファイナンスも新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）もうまく進む」とし、将来的には需要の多い米国での上場や現地生産も「あり得る話だ」と語った。

ロイターのインタビューで述べた。ラピダスへの政府からの研究開発委託費はこれまでに約２兆４０００億円に達する。昨年７月に北海道千歳市の拠点で回路線幅２ナノメートル級半導体の試作品の動作を確認し、量産に向けた調整を進めている。山際氏は「絶対大丈夫だという根拠もないような自信を示すのも誠実ではないし、全然ダメだという悲観論も否定していいと思う。来年の今ごろまでには量産体制を整え、チップが量産される姿を世の中に示すことが大事だ」と述べた。

日本の半導体産業は１９８０年代にシェアトップを誇ったが、日米半導体協定による貿易規制が強まる中で衰退を余儀なくされた。山際氏は「敗戦」の反省から、今回は最初から米国企業と組み「ウィンウィンの関係」を志向していることや、「中途半端に公の支援をやめず、最後の最後まで政府もコミットする」という姿勢が数十年前の半導体戦略と大きく異なる点だとした。

ＡＩ・半導体は高市早苗政権が掲げる１７の戦略分野の筆頭に掲げられている。山際氏は「経済を使った威圧が普通に行われる世の中になってしまった。日本がこれから先も世界の中で輝く国として存在し続けるためには、必須の物質である半導体をわれわれの武器にする以外に生き残る道はない」と強調した。

半導体業界では、韓国のＳＫハイニックスが日本でのメモリー半導体工場建設を検討していると報じられている。山際氏は韓国勢の進出について「製造拠点が日本にあればサプライチェーン（供給網）が強くなる。基本的には歓迎されるべきものだ」としつつ、日韓協力については韓国の中ロ両国との距離感を踏まえ、技術や人材流出のリスクと比較衡量して「どこまでなら一緒にやれるかは厳しく見なくてはいけない」と語った。台湾についても親中派の政権が発足した場合のリスクがあると述べた。

自民党の自動車議連の事務局長も務める山際氏は、車載ソフトウェアを無線通信で更新する「ＯＴＡ（オーバー・ジ・エア）」技術を備えた中国製電気自動車（ＥＶ）について、外部からコントロールされ、一斉停止や暴走が引き起こされるといった「経済安全保障上のリスクを考えざるを得ない。中国製の車をそこまで信用していいかどうかはきちんと議論して結論を出さなければいけなくなると思う」と話した。

＜飲食料品の減税は「必ず通す。所与のもの」＞

山際氏は、自民党の税制調査会小委員長も務める。飲食料品の消費税率を２０２７年４月から１％に引き下げる政府方針については、帝国データバンクの調査で日本経済の活性化に「つながらない」との回答が過半数を占めるなど異論も多い。山際氏は「賛否両論あるのは認識している。物価高対策としてやるものなので、経済浮揚効果というよりは、痛みを緩めるためのものだと考えてほしい」と説明。

消費税減税は高市首相の公約で「国民との約束は果たすのが当たり前だ」とし、少数与党の参議院で法案が否決されても「衆議院に戻して必ず通す。（減税は）所与のものとして扱ってもらった方が良い」と語った。

※インタビューは２４日に実施しました。

items.title: ＥＵ、米ディーゼル輸出禁止計画報道で高官級協議　影響懸念
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブリュッセル ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブリュッセル ２４日 ロイター] - 欧州委員会のオロフ・ギル報道官は２４日、米国によるディーゼル燃料の輸出禁止計画が報じられていることを受け、欧州連合（ＥＵ）と米国の間で高官級の協議を行っていると明らかにした。ＥＵは、計画が実施されれば双方に悪影響を及ぼす恐れがあるとみている。

米政治専門サイトのポリティコは、１１月の中間選挙を前にディーゼル価格が急騰する中、米国が９０日間の輸出禁止を準備していると報道。ただ、ライト米エネルギー長官は否定している。

ギル氏は「ＥＵと米政権の間で高官級の接触が行われている。緊密なパートナーであれば、共有市場に影響を及ぼす措置を講じる前に相互に協議することを期待する」と述べた。

アナリストによると、米国のディーゼル輸出禁止による国内価格の抑制効果はほとんどない一方、欧州や他の地域については、部分的な禁輸でも品不足につながる可能性があるという。

ディーゼル価格は、在庫の減少と、ウクライナや中東での戦争による混乱を背景に急騰している。米国に次いで世界第２位の輸出国であるロシアは７月にディーゼルの輸出を禁止、その後９月末まで禁輸期間を延長した。

ＥＵはディーゼルの純輸入地域で、供給量が減少すれば中南米、アフリカ、アジアの輸入国と競争する必要に迫られることになる。

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [東京 ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[東京 ２５日 ロイター] - 寄り付きの東京株式市場で日経平均は、前営業日比０．１９％（１２５円６３銭）高の６万５６３９円６２銭と、続伸してスタートした。前日の米国株は小動きだったため手掛かり材料難で、引き続き金利上昇が懸念されているが、半導体関連株を中心に幅広く物色されて始まった。ＴＯＰＩＸも高寄りし、午前９時０５分現在で、前日終値からの上昇率が０．７％と、日経平均の０．５％を上回っている。

個別ではＡＩ（人工知能）・半導体関連でアドバンテストや東京エレクトロンがしっかりでスタートしたほか、トヨタ自動車、三菱ＵＦＪフィナンシャル・グループなども堅調。指数寄与度の高いファーストリテイリングも小高い面、ソフトバンクグループはさえない。

items.title: Chile's Escondida mine gradually resumes operations after fatal accident
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Operations at BHP's Escondida mine in Chile are being resumed progressively as assessments continue, the world's largest copper mine said on Thursday.
items.body:
Operations at BHP's (BHP.AX) Escondida mine in Chile are being resumed progressively as assessments continue, the world's largest copper mine said on Thursday.
Operations at the mine were suspended [USN:S0N44A00V TEXT:"on Wednesday"] after a worker was killed in an accident while carrying out maintenance work.
"The Company continues to assess the conditions for a gradual resumption of Mine activities, taking into account workforce wellbeing, operational readiness, risk controls and applicable authority requirements," the company said in a statement.
Other operational areas outside Mine Operations were also paused following the incident, with certain activities continuing at reduced rates.
In Chile, mines typically can only resume operations following a fatal accident once safety inspectors verify that conditions are safe.
Escondida is located in Chile's northern Atacama Desert. BHP operates the mine, while Rio Tinto (RIO.L) holds a 30% stake and Japan-based JECO Corp owns 12.5%.

items.title: ゼレンスキー氏、ウクライナ復興へ投資呼びかけ　ウォール街幹部と協議
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はウォール街の大手金融機関の幹部らと協議を行った。ウクライナ政府は復興資金を賄うため投資の呼び込みを目指している。

ウクライナ政府によると、協議は２３日、ニューヨークで開催された第８１回国連総会に合わせて行われ、主にウクライナが冬を乗り切るための支援や、経済の下支えといった分野に焦点が当てられた。

ウクライナは厳しい冬に直面している。ロシアがインフラや主要な輸出産業への攻撃を強化する中、財政危機が深まっているためだ。戦争のコストは今年、１日当たり約１億９０００万ドルに膨らんでいる。

協議には米企業２０社超が出席し、米銀大手シティグループと米商工会議所が調整役を務めた。

ウクライナ政府によると、参加者は政府系ファンドの設立や、国際諮問グループのメンバーの支援を通じたウクライナ経済の強化についても協議した。

シティのジェーン・フレイザー最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）は声明で「復興では民間セクターが不可欠な役割を果たすことになる」と述べた。ウクライナで２５年以上事業を展開してきたシティは、投資の呼び込みを支援し、ウクライナ企業を後押ししたい考えを示した。

items.title: Legendary hoops icon Bob Pettit dies at 93
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Basketball legend Bob Pettit, a Hall of Famer and first winner of the NBA's MVP award, has died. He was 93.
items.body:
Basketball legend Bob Pettit, a Hall of Famer and first winner of the NBA's MVP award, has died. He was 93.
The 11-time NBA All-Star and two-time college All-American at LSU died Wednesday in the New Orleans suburb of Metairie. No cause of death was divulged.
"Dad passed away very peacefully at his home in Metairie, on Wednesday, September 23," the Pettit family said in a statement. "He was the most amazing father. The most kind, humble and gentle soul. We are so blessed to have him in our lives and we will miss him dearly."
Pettit, a member of the NBA's 75th Anniversary Team, was a two-time NBA MVP, a two-time scoring champion and a four-time All-Star MVP during his 11 seasons (1954-65). He also helped revolutionize the then-new power forward position and was elected to the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame in 1971.
He was Rookie of the Year for the Milwaukee Hawks in 1954-55 before the team moved to St. Louis for the final 10 seasons of Pettit's career. He was MVP in the 1955-56 and 1958-59 seasons and averaged 26.4 points, 16.2 rebounds and 3.0 assists in 792 career regular-season games.
The Hawks made nine playoff appearances during his career -- reaching the NBA Finals four times -- and won the 1957-58 championship. Pettit was named MVP of the Finals while averaging 29.3 points and 17.0 rebounds. He became the first player to score 50 points in an NBA Finals game when he hit the mark in the clinching Game 6 victory over the Boston Celtics.
The 50 points is still tied for sixth most in NBA Finals history. Elgin Baylor holds the mark of 61, set in 1962 for the Los Angeles Lakers.
In 88 career playoff games, Pettit averaged 25.5 points and 14.8 rebounds.
Pettit averaged a career-best 31.1 points in 1961-62, finishing third behind legendary Wilt Chamberlain (50.4) as well as Walt Bellamy (31.6). He averaged a career best 20.3 rebounds in 1960-61, which was good for just third behind Chamberlain (27.2) and Bill Russell (23.9).
Pettit was one of the game's biggest stars in an era before NBA was regularly on television. He retired at age 32, partly because of a balky knee and also due to a banking opportunity.
"The Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame mourns the passing of Bob Pettit, a sleek, skilled big man who revolutionized the forward position during his career," the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame said in a statement. "The 11-time NBA All-Star and 2-time MVP retired as the all-time leading scorer in NBA history and left an enduring legacy. He led the St. Louis Hawks to the 1958 NBA championship over the Boston Celtics. The Basketball Hall of Fame salutes this true giant of the game."
The Hawks moved to Atlanta ahead of the 1968-69 season and the franchise paid tribute to Pettit on Thursday.
"Beyond his accolades -- including 11 All-Star selections and leading the Hawks to the 1958 NBA Championship -- Bob was a true ambassador for the sport and a role model for countless fans," the team said. "We are grateful for his contributions to our franchise and to basketball history. His retired No. 9 jersey continues to hang proudly at State Farm Arena as a lasting reminder of the impact he made on our organization. We extend our deepest condolences to Bob's family, friends and loved ones during this difficult time."
A native of Baton Rouge, Pettit stayed home to play college basketball at LSU. He averaged 27.4 points and 14.4 rebounds in 72 games over three seasons. He was a first-team All-American in 1953-54 when he averaged 31.4 points and 17.3 rebounds.
Pettit was a second-team All-American the previous season as a junior.
Pettit's 31.4 scoring average was a Southeastern Conference record until another LSU legend, Pete Maravich, surpassed it with a 43.8 average in 1967-68.
LSU unveiled a statue outside of the Pete Maravich Assembly Center in 2016. A street in Baton Rouge, Bob Pettit Blvd., is also named after him.
After being the second overall pick in the 1954 NBA Draft by the Hawks, Pettit received a then-NBA record rookie record contract of $11,000.
"I had only $100 in the bank when I graduated from college," Pettit recalled later, according to LSU, "and $11,000 looked like all the money in the world to me."
--Field Level Media

items.title: Saudi Grand Mufti tells troops to be ready to sacrifice their lives fighting Houthis
items.author: Timour Azhari, Hatem Maher
items.creator: Timour Azhari, Hatem Maher
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's top religious authority called on soldiers in the kingdom to be ready to lay down their lives to fight the Iran-backed Houthis until the group is ousted from power, a statement posted on the Saudi state news agency said.
items.body:
Saudi Arabia's top religious authority called on soldiers in the kingdom to be ready to lay down their lives to fight the Iran-backed Houthis until the group is ousted from power, a statement posted on the Saudi state news agency said.
The rare and strongly worded message by Saudi Grand Mufti Sheikh Saleh bin Fawzan Al-Fawzan was addressed to soldiers stationed at the country's borders and drew heavily on Quranic verses and recorded sayings of the Prophet Mohammad related to sacrifice and struggle in defence of God.
It comes after weeks of escalating violence between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis which has seen the Iran-backed group attack the kingdom with salvos of missiles and drones and Saudi Arabia respond with airstrikes.
Observers have been questioning whether Saudi Arabia will launch a broader military operation along with Yemeni government forces it backs.
"Protecting this great nation... and punishing anyone who seeks to lay a hand on even an inch of its territory are among the greatest duties and most virtuous acts of devotion, for which lives and souls may be sacrificed in seeking God's pleasure," said the statement, issued late Thursday.
Asserting the authority of the Saudi-backed internationally recognized Yemeni government over the entire country was "among the most pressing obligations," it added.
Those government forces lost control of the vital Bab el-Mandeb waterway to the Houthis two weeks back, a blow to the kingdom, which has been mired in the conflict since 2015 after it launched an unsuccessful operation to oust the Houthis from the Yemeni capital Sanaa.
The recent fighting is the latest episode in 12 years of civil war in Yemen which had largely been frozen since a 2022 but has escalated again and has become linked to the wider Iran war.
"We ask God Almighty to grant you all his support, and to protect our countries and beloved Yemen from all harm. We also ask him to bring about the complete defeat of the Houthi group and those who assist and support them," the statement said.
The Mufti's letter adds to a growing religiously centered narrative by authorities in the conservative Sunni Muslim kingdom aimed at discrediting the Houthis, who follow a different sect of Islam.
State TV has in recent weeks aired footage of an alleged Houthi strike on a mosque in the kingdom's south, and authorities have also accused the Houthis of launching an attack on Mecca, Islam's holiest site.
"It is incumbent upon you, brothers serving on the front lines, to remain constantly prepared to perform your duty, to obey the rulers and your field commanders, and to carry out orders with the utmost precision, as God Almighty commanded the companions of his Prophet to do," the statement said.
"You are following in the footsteps of the Prophet's companions, defending the sacred sites of Muslims."

items.title: 北朝鮮、韓国が米集団防衛の拠点なら「報復の標的」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ソウル ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ソウル ２５日 ロイター] - 北朝鮮は２５日、韓国が米国主導の集団防衛体制の中核拠点となれば、集団的報復の「決定的な標的」になると表明した。国営の朝鮮中央通信（ＫＣＮＡ）が伝えた。

ＫＣＮＡの論評で、敵国研究所の部門責任者とされるカン・チョルス氏は、米国が同盟国である韓国を世界覇権追求のための拠点に変え、海外紛争で真っ先に展開する足場として利用していると非難した。

韓国を集団防衛の要と位置付けた在韓米軍司令官の発言を引き合いに出し、合同軍事演習や米軍の展開を批判した。

論評は、北朝鮮側が対抗措置を準備しており、自国の安全保障への挑戦を容赦なく粉砕すると主張した。

在韓米軍のコメントは得られていない。

米国は韓国におよそ２万８５００人の兵力を駐留させている。

Five takeaways from Trump's summit with Xi in Washington

The US secured an extension of its trade truce this week - but only a short one.

US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping walk along the Colonnade of the White House, on Sep 24, 2026, in Washington. (Photo: AP/Jacquelyn Martin)

WASHINGTON: US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday (Sep 24), with talks on trade and artificial intelligence and the growing strategic rivalry between the countries all in the spotlight during an elaborate state visit.
Here are some major takeaways from the talks:
TRADE DEAL EXTENDED, FOR NOW T he US secured an extension of its trade truce this week - but only a short one.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the two sides agreed to extend by two months a trade agreement that ended last year's trade war and was due to expire in November. The extension would give Washington and Beijing "more time to see what we can do on the economic front," he said.

But rather than locking in a durable agreement, the extension appears to push the central questions — tariffs, Chinese purchases, rare-earth supplies and technology restrictions — into the next round of negotiations.
Bessent said on Wednesday that Beijing was meeting its requirement in the earlier agreement to buy 25 million tons of soybeans but was lagging on its pledge to buy US$17 billion in other agricultural goods. US officials have said rare-earth deliveries were also falling short, another sign that significant gaps remain.
For companies, the result is a familiar form of instability: tariff rates remain lower for now, but decisions must still be made against a shifting policy backdrop.

Related:

Trump's state dinner for Xi features sea bass and a long list of tech titans

Trump-Xi summit in Washington begins with great fanfare but low expectations

DRESS TO IMPRESS For Trump , Xi 's White House visit was an opportunity to show off a Washington being remade in his image.
After Xi treated Trump in Beijing to a tour around a Ming dynasty temple and a walled-off garden retreat rarely opened to foreigners, the US president returned the favor with a different kind of spectacle: Troops wearing wigs and tri-corner hats marched in formation and played music in a Rose Garden redesigned to look like a Trump golf club.
Fighter jets and bombers roared overhead during ceremonies staged on Wednesday and Thursday, one so loud it caused Trump to flinch.
When the White House press corps was called to cover the two leaders, it wasn’t to hear them talk about the weighty affairs of state. Instead, it was to watch them tour the Marine One helicopter and the recently redesigned South Lawn of the White House, replete with a large helipad emblazoned with the presidential seal.
Speaking to reporters, Trump brushed away questions about their policy discussions.
“He loves good granite,” Trump said of Xi . “Great meeting.”
XI WANTS US "PRUDENCE" OVER TAIWAN As expected, Xi pressed Trump on the Taiwan issue, saying, according to China's official news agency, that China hoped the United States would "handle the Taiwan question with prudence. "
The agency's English-language service also wrote that Xi hoped the US would oppose Taiwan independence.
That would be a tougher version of Washington's long-standing formulation that it does not "support" independence. There are no signs that the Trump administration plans to change its wording.
There was no immediate White House readout of the exchange, but US officials have long avoided explicitly stating opposition to Taiwanese independence. Any shift in language would raise questions about Washington's resolve to defend the island and provoke opposition in Congress.

Related:

Trump-Xi summit: Xi Jinping calls for US and China to be partners rather than rivals

Trump’s high-level welcome for Xi puts personal diplomacy in focus, analysts say

STRATEGIC RISK Xi , not for the first time while meeting Trump , invoked the "Thucydides Trap", an academic theory that competition between a rising power and an established one tends toward war.
While the Chinese leader said the risk "can be overcome," his reference underscored how concerns about a potential US-China military conflict continue to shadow relations between the world's two largest powers.
Xi argued that both nations stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation, and he called for regular military dialogue and stronger crisis-prevention mechanisms.
Trump , for his part, drew on the two nations' shared history to emphasize the potential for cooperation. They could accomplish much by pursuing common interests, he said, invoking their wartime alliance against Japan.
DIFFERENCES ON AI The two leaders expressed diverging views about artificial intelligence.
Trump, who has declared that AI should be called super intelligence, or SI, said in a social media post that he wants “to leave it exactly where it is" and rely on the US Department of Justice rather than impose any new guardrails. He insisted that China held the same position.
But Xi said on Thursday that, as leading nations on AI, China and the US must manage its growth.
“We have both the capability and responsibility to develop and manage AI for good, and ensure that the development of AI is always under human control and serves the well-being of the people,” Xi said.
Some of the biggest names in AI were expected to attend Trump's state dinner at the White House on Thursday for Xi, including Alphabet's (GOOGL.O) Sundar Pichai, OpenAI's Sam Altman and Nvidia's (NVDA.O) Jensen Huang.

Source: Reuters/bg

items.title: Trump e CEOs do setor de tecnologia discutirão IA na 3ª feira, diz fonte
items.author: Courtney Rozen, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Courtney Rozen, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, o presidente da Câmara dos Deputados, o republicano Mike Johnson, e CEOs do setor de tecnologia realizarão uma reunião sobre inteligência artificial na próxima terça-feira, informou na noite desta quinta-feira uma fonte a par do encontro previsto.
items.body:
O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, o presidente da Câmara dos Deputados, o republicano Mike Johnson, e CEOs do setor de tecnologia realizarão uma reunião sobre inteligência artificial na próxima terça-feira, informou na noite desta quinta-feira uma fonte a par do encontro previsto.
As principais empresas de inteligência artificial do mundo alertaram para os riscos que a IA representa para a humanidade, fazendo um apelo aos governos que trabalhem juntos para gerenciar essa tecnologia cada vez mais poderosa.
Governos em todo o mundo têm enfrentado dificuldades para acompanhar os rápidos avanços na IA.
A reunião havia sido noticiada anteriormente pela Axios. Não foram divulgados detalhes.
Os Estados Unidos e a China, as duas principais potências no desenvolvimento de IA, adotaram abordagens diferentes em relação à regulamentação.
Trump argumentou que os EUA não precisam de novas regulamentações específicas para a IA, enquanto a China impôs regras que regem os algoritmos de IA e os dados de treinamento, incluindo a exigência de que o conteúdo gerado por IA seja claramente identificado.
Trump disse aos líderes mundiais na Assembleia Geral da ONU na terça-feira que “rejeita qualquer tentativa de construir um esquema globalista para controlar” a IA, descrevendo a tecnologia como incrível, mas observando que os EUA agirão com cautela.

items.title: NSE becomes world's sixth largest bourse with $47 billion m-cap
items.author: Sachin Kumar and Jaikishan Yadav
items.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India has recently reached an impressive market capitalisation nearing $47 billion. Shares began trading at ₹1,800, slightly above the issue price of ₹1,785. With a price-to-earnings ratio of 43 times, it outperforms many global exchanges. Experts predict a strong growth in India’s capital markets, estimating an annual cash market turnover increase of 14-16%. Additionally, NSE's operating Ebitda margin of 66.
items.body: ET Intelligence Group: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) has become the sixth largest bourse in the world in terms of market capitalisation after its listing on Thursday. Its market cap reached nearly $47 billion (₹4.5 lakh crore) after its shares closed at ₹1,818 on the BSE. The stock debuted at ₹1,800 against the issue price of ₹1,785. NSE, the country's largest stock exchange by total turnover in the cash and equity derivatives segments, trades at a price-to-earnings multiple of 43 times, the highest among its listed global peers. The valuation premium reflects its superior Ebitda margin and investors' expectations of stronger earnings growth driven by growing financialisation of household savings.134472447Intercontinental Exchange (ICE), the parent of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) is the largest listed bourse with $87.8 billion market cap, followed by Hong Kong Exchanges & Clearing and Deutsche Borse with market caps of $63.6 billion and $59.5 billion respectively, according to Bloomberg. Nasdaq and London Stock Exchange Group has $53.3 billion and $53 billion market cap.Read more: NSE shares list with gains on debut day: How much Radhakishan Damani, Raamdeo Agrawal & other ace investors’ stakes are now worthDespite having a smaller market cap base, NSE's P/E multiple is well above the range of 25-30 times for the top five global exchanges and also exceeds the 24-34 times range at which the 10 largest listed exchange operators trade.Read more: Snapdeal parent AceVector raises Rs 189 crore from anchors; Negen, Singularity among top investorsIndia's capital markets are expected to see strong structural growth, supported by rising incomes, greater financialisation of savings and increasing retail participation. According to a Redseer report, India's cash market turnover is projected to grow annually at a 14-16% to ₹473-507 lakh crore by FY30 from ₹280 lakh crore in FY26. NSE also compares favourably with its global peers on operating profitability. Its operating Ebitda margin of 66.9% is at the upper end of the 53-80% range of the five largest listed exchange operators.

items.title: What Is The Thucydides Trap and Why Did Xi Raise It With Trump?
items.author: Rebecca Choong Wilkins
items.creator: Rebecca Choong Wilkins
items.summary: When China’s President Xi Jinping met US leader Donald Trump in Washington on Thursday he called for greater cooperation between the two countries to avoid the “Thucydides Trap”. It’s a phrase that sounds academic, but it goes to the heart of Beijing’s ambitions for their relationship. And it’s not the first time Xi has invoked it: he raised the same idea when Trump visited China in May.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２４日　ロイター］ - 米大リーグ（ＭＬＢ）カブスのＰＣＡことピート・クロウアームストロング外野手は２４日、史上７人目となる「シーズン４０本塁打・４０盗塁を達成した。

すでに今季４５本塁打を放っているクロウアームストロングは、この日のマーリンズ戦の初回に二盗を成功して４０盗塁に到達。２０２４年の大谷翔平選手（ドジャース）以来となる「４０─４０」達成者となった。

過去にＭＬＢで「４０─４０」を達成したのは、ホセ・カンセコ（１９８８年に４２本塁打・４０盗塁）、バリー・ボンズ（１９９６年に４２本塁打・４０盗塁）、アレックス・ロドリゲス（１９９８年に４２本塁打・４６盗塁）、アルフォンソ・ソリアーノ（２００６年に４６本塁打・４１盗塁）、ロナルド・アクーニャ・ジュニア（２０２３年に４１本塁打・７３盗塁）、そして大谷（２０２４年に５４本塁打・５９盗塁）とそうそうたる顔ぶれだ。

ＭＬＢ公式サイトによると、カブスの編成本部長を務めるジェド・ホイヤー氏は「本当に素晴らしいことだと思う。史上７人目の快挙だ。名を連ねる選手たちも実に豪華だし、本当に素敵なことだと思う」とＰＣＡの偉業をたたえた。

items.title: BHP dice labores en chilena Escondida se reanudan a medida que avanzan evaluaciones tras accidente
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las operaciones en la mina Escondida de BHP en Chile se reanudan de forma progresiva mientras prosiguen las evaluaciones tras un accidente fatal, informó el jueves la mayor mina de cobre del mundo.
items.body:
Las operaciones en la mina Escondida de BHP en Chile se reanudan de forma progresiva mientras prosiguen las evaluaciones tras un accidente fatal, informó el jueves la mayor mina de cobre del mundo.
Las operaciones se suspendieron el miércoles después de que un trabajador falleciera en un accidente mientras realizaba labores de mantenimiento.
"La compañía continúa evaluando las condiciones para una reanudación gradual de las actividades mineras, teniendo en cuenta el bienestar de la fuerza laboral, la preparación operativa, los controles de riesgo y los requisitos de las autoridades competentes", dijo en una declaración.
Otras áreas operativas ajenas a las operaciones de mina también se paralizaron tras el incidente, aunque ciertas actividades continuaron a un ritmo reducido, agregó.
En Chile, usualmente las minas solo reinician faenas tras un accidente fatal una vez que las autoridades verifican que las condiciones son seguras.
Escondida está en el norteño desierto de Atacama y asocia a BHP con Rio Tinto (RIO.L) y la japonesa JECO.

items.title: 戦争終結は米国次第、イランは継続望まず＝ペゼシュキアン大統領
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Kanishka Singh

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - イランのペゼシュキアン大統領は２４日に放送されたインタビューで、イラン戦争がいつ終わるかは米国次第だと述べた。年内に紛争が終結する可能性があるかとの問いに答えた。

ＦＯＸニュースのインタビューで「われわれは（戦争の）継続を望んでいない。これを終わらせるかどうかを選ばなければならないのは米国だ」と述べた。

ペゼシュキアン氏は２３日、国連総会の一般討論演説で、米国との戦争でイランが降伏することはないと述べた。

トランプ米大統領は２２日、戦闘終結に向けた合意に至らなければイランを「壊滅」させることができると述べる一方、近く合意が実現する可能性も示唆した。

items.title: North Korea says South Korea a target if it becomes US collective defence hub
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: North Korea said on Friday that South Korea would become a "decisive target" for collective retaliation if it served as a central hub in a US-led collective defence system, state media KCNA reported.
items.body:
North Korea said on Friday that South Korea would become a "decisive target" for collective retaliation if it served as a central hub in a US-led collective defence system, state media KCNA reported.
In a KCNA commentary, Kang Chol Su, described as a department director at the Institute for Enemy State Studies, accused Washington of turning its ally South Korea into a base for pursuing global hegemony and using it as a platform to deploy first in overseas conflicts.
Kang cited remarks by the commander of US Forces Korea portraying South Korea as a key centre of collective defence and criticised joint drills and US deployments.
The commentary said Pyongyang had prepared countermeasures and would ruthlessly crush challenges to its security.
US Forces Korea did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The United States stations about 28,500 military personnel in South Korea to help deter aggression from North Korea.

items.title: 英中銀副総裁、利上げ「ますます適切に」　インフレ加速で
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ロンドン ２４日 ロイター] - イングランド銀行（英中央銀行）のブリーデン副総裁（金融安定担当）は２４日、インフレリスクの増大に利上げで対応することが「ますます適切になる」と述べた。

ブリーデン氏は英国立経済社会研究所が主催した「ＵＫマクロ政策フォーラム」で、エネルギー価格の高騰による二次的影響の兆候を確認するために政策対応を長く待ち過ぎると、後悔することになりかねないと指摘した。

この発言は、金融政策委員会（ＭＰＣ）で最近見られる論調の変化と一致する内容で、１１月の利上げに道を開く可能性がある。欧州中央銀行（ＥＣＢ）と米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）は既に利上げに踏み切っている。

ブリーデン氏は「ショックが大きく、長引くほど、政策対応が必要となる重大な二次的影響が生じる可能性は高まる」とした上で、「（利上げに票を投じる用意という意味で）９月時点ではその段階になかったが、リスクバランスが変化したことは意識しており、リスクが顕在化するにつれ、政策金利による対応がますます適切になる」と語った。

金融市場が今後１年間で約１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）の利上げを織り込んでいることについて問われると、１１月に予定される次回の政策決定に注目していると答えた。

「私にとって今の問題は『最初の一手が必要か』ということだ。それ以上の利上げが必要かどうかは、経済とそこに加わったショックがここからどう展開するかに左右されると思う」と述べた。また、市場の利上げ織り込みの変化を英中銀は無視できないとの考えも示した。

ロンバルデリ副総裁も２４日、エネルギー価格が高止まりすれば、景気悪化の明確な証拠がない限り、利上げが必要になる公算が大きいと述べた。

items.title: ＮＳＳＫとＣＶＣから非公開化の初期提案を受領＝一部報道で小林製薬
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［東京　２５日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［東京　２５日　ロイター］ - 小林製薬は２５日、日本産業推進機構（ＮＳＳＫ）とＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズから非公開化の提案を受けたとの一部報道を受け、両社の関連法人から「株式の非公開化にかかる法的拘束力のない初期的な共同提案を受領していることは事実」とのコメントを発表した。

現時点で決定した事実はなく、今後、開示すべき事実を決定した場合は速やかに公表するという。

日本経済新聞など国内メディアは２４日、小林製薬が株式の非公開化を検討していると報じた。日経は、ＮＳＳＫと欧州系投資ファンドのＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズが買収を提案したとし、小林製薬の創業家も一部出資する方向で検討しているもようと伝えた。

日本経済新聞など国内メディアは２４日、小林製薬が株式の非公開化を検討していると報じた。日経は、ＮＳＳＫと欧州系投資ファンドのＣＶＣキャピタル・パートナーズが買収を提案したとし、小林製薬の創業家も一部出資する方向で検討しているもようと伝えた。

items.title: アルゼンチンの貧困率が32％に上昇、次期大統領選を左右も
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ブエノスアイレス ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ブエノスアイレス ２４日 ロイター] - アルゼンチン国家統計局（ＩＮＤＥＣ）が２４日発表した２０２６年上半期の貧困率は人口の３２．３％に達し、２５年下半期の２８．２％から上昇した。アルゼンチン・カトリック大学（ＵＣＡ）の推計によると、貧困率は２６年末までに３５％まで上昇する可能性がある。

これらは２５年に貧困率を２８％まで低下させたミレイ大統領の実績が後退していることを意味しており、１年超後の次期大統領選挙でミレイ大統領が再選できるかどうかの命運を左右することにもなりそうだ。

ＵＣＡのアルゼンチン社会負債観測所の所長アグスティン・サルビア氏は「過去４四半期は、四半期ごとに４０万―４５万人が貧困に陥った」と指摘する。

コンサルティング会社テネオの中南米担当マネージングディレクター、ニコラス・ワトソン氏は「貧困率の緩やかな上昇は、ミレイ政権下で見られた大幅な減少を帳消しにするものではない」としながらも、「改善の比較的容易な段階は終わったことを示唆している」と述べた。

長年にわたる高インフレに反発する低・中所得層の有権者の強力な支持を得て２３年１２月に就任したミレイ氏は、リバタリアン（自由至上主義者）を標榜。インフレ率を劇的に押し下げ、財政を安定させたものの、支援団体関係者らによると生活費で苦労している国民が増えている。

首都ブエノスアイレス近郊のコミュニティーホールで、アナ・バレットさんは物々交換会の運営を手伝っている。ここでは現金の代わりに物々交換をしており、過去の経済危機に見られた慣行を復活させている。

バレットさんは「貧困は劇的に深刻化している」と指摘。食用油や砂糖、小麦粉、パスタなどが最も需要が大きい品目であり、これらはしばしば古着や家庭用品と交換されていると話す。

最新の世論調査によると、調査対象となった低所得層の回答者の間でミレイ氏の支持率が急落した。このため前回大統領選で勝利の鍵となった支持基盤をつなぎ留められるのかどうかが疑問視されている。

昨年９月に実施されたアトラスインテルの世論調査によると、月収約６５０ドル以下の低所得層の不支持率は７０％弱に上昇し、支持率は３０％弱に下落した。前年はそれぞれ５７％、３７％だった。

全体ではミレイ氏の不支持率は５８％、支持率が３８．１％だった。

トランプ米大統領と中国の習近平国家主席は24日、ワシントンで首脳会談を行った。ここで議論された主要テーマについて、ホワイトハウス担当のトレバー・ハニカット記者が解説する。

　◇

ロイター　ホワイトハウス担当記者　トレバー・ハニカット

中国の習近平国家主席は3年ぶりに訪米し、ホワイトハウスでトランプ大統領と米中関係の主要課題について協議した。両氏が話し合った主要議題は3つある。
まず貿易では、双方は関税休戦を2カ月延長することで合意した。これにより、一時は税率が数百パーセントに達していた関税の引き上げは回避される。中国経済にとって朗報だ。中国経済は内需の弱さを、米国を含む各国への好調な輸出で補ってきた。

AIについて、習主席は技術のリスクを警戒する姿勢を示し、AIが人間の管理下にとどまるようにする必要性や、社会の利益のために責任を持って開発される必要性に言及した。
一方のトランプ氏はAIについてはるかに楽観的で、自身が「スーパーインテリジェンス（超知能）」と呼ぶものについて、何ら変更を望まないと述べた。

また両首脳は台湾についても話し合った。習主席は非公開の会談でトランプ氏に対し、台湾独立に反対するよう迫った。
台湾問題は両首脳の過去の対話でも大きな争点となってきた。そのため、トランプ氏が台湾について従来とは異なる立場を示すよう迫られる形となっている。
議会が承認済みの140億ドル規模の対台湾武器売却について、大統領とホワイトハウスは現在、判断を保留している。この問題でトランプ氏がどのような結論を出すかは、会談後の主要な焦点の一つだ。

items.title: 米中首脳会談、民主党が批判　「演出重視で中身なし」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Patricia Zengerle

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Patricia Zengerle

[ワシントン ２４日 ロイター] - 米民主党の上院議員は２４日、トランプ大統領と中国の習近平国家主席による会談について、人工知能（ＡＩ）、貿易、重要鉱物、台湾向け武器供与といった問題における実質的な内容よりも、華美な演出が優先されたと批判した。

首脳会談は儀礼的な演出が目立った一方、具体的な成果は乏しく、懸案事項について特段の進展は見られなかった。

ロイターが確認した声明には、民主党会派４７人のうち少なくとも１９人が署名。米議会が台湾向けに承認した１５０億ドル超の安全保障支援（１３億ドルの資金と１４０億ドル規模の武器売却パッケージ）を直ちに実施するとともに、人権問題への取り組みと、不当に拘束されている米国人の解放に向け働きかけるようトランプ氏に求めた。

民主党はまた、中国向け高性能半導体の販売規制を緩和したトランプ氏の対応も批判。米中間の関税休戦の延長については、世界のレアアース（希土類）精製を中国が握っているといったサプライチェーン（供給網）の問題に十分に対処するものではないとの見解を示した。

items.title: Iran's president says it is up to US to choose if it wants to end Iran war
items.author: Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Kanishka Singh
items.summary: Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said it was up to the United States to choose when the Iran war will end, when asked if the conflict could end by the end of the year.
items.body:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian said it was up to the United States to choose when the Iran war will end, when asked if the conflict could end by the end of the year.
"But we do not wish to continue. It's America that must choose whether it wants to end this or not," Pezeshkian said, responding to the question in an interview aired on Thursday on Fox News' "Special Report with Bret Baier" show.
Iran's president told the UN General Assembly on Wednesday Tehran would never surrender to US pressure as the two sides have remained far apart on how to end the war.
US President Donald Trump said on Tuesday he could "[USN:L8N45E0CI TEXT:"annihilate"]" Iran if there is no deal to end the war, but also suggested an agreement could come soon.
Trump has [USN:L4N4061X8 TEXT:"offered shifting goals"] and timelines for the war that began on February 28 when the US and Israel attacked Iran and Tehran responded with its own strikes on Israel and Gulf states that host US bases.
US-Israeli strikes on Iran and Israeli attacks on Lebanon have [USN:L1N3ZR14Q TEXT:"killed thousands"] and [USN:L6N3ZY0Q0 TEXT:"displaced millions"].
Trump has cited weakening Iran's nuclear capabilities as one of his war objectives.
Iran, which does not have nuclear weapons, denies seeking them. The US is nuclear-armed.
Tehran says it has the right to develop nuclear technology for peaceful purposes as a party to the nuclear [USN:L1N42N0IE TEXT:"Non-Proliferation Treaty (NPT)"].

items.title: サッカー＝日本代表、ウルグアイに3得点で勝利　国際親善試合
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［２４日　ロイター］ - サッカーの日本代表は２４日、宮城県のキューアンドエースタジアムみやぎでウルグアイとの国際親善試合に臨み、３─１で勝利した。

ワールドカップ（Ｗ杯）北中米３カ国大会後の初戦となった試合で、日本は前半１１分にＡ代表デビュー戦となる松木玖生が左足のミドルシュートをゴール左に決めて先制。しかし、同４２分に自陣でのボールロストから最後はマキシミリアノ・アラウホにネットを揺らされ、追いつかれた。

後半、日本は１─１のまま迎えたアディショナルタイム１分、途中出場の塩貝健人が上田のアシストからＡ代表初ゴールをマークして勝ち越し。さらに同６分には伊東純也のパスから上田綺世がダメ押し弾を記録した。

日本はこの後、２８日の国際親善試合でベネズエラ代表と対戦する。

［２４日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２４日、卓球の団体決勝を行い、男子は日本が中国を下して６０年ぶりの金メダルを獲得した。

日本は松島輝空が第１試合で敗れたものの、第２試合で張本智和が勝利。第３試合に戸上隼輔が敗れたことで後がなくなったが、ここから張本と松島が連勝し、逆転での優勝を決めた。

items.title: 英がイランに警告、国内の敵対活動容認せず　外相会談で＝報道
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[２４日 ロイター] - 英国のミリバンド外相はイランのアラグチ外相との会談で、イランとつながりのある組織による「英国内での威嚇、脅迫、敵対活動を容認しない」と警告した。英スカイニュースが２４日報じた。

英外務省の話として、両外相が国連総会に合わせてニューヨークで会談したと伝えた。 

両氏は中東での戦争やホルムズ海峡再開の重要性に加え、「英国内でイランとつながりのある集団からの脅威に対抗する揺るぎない決意」について協議したという。

英国家サイバーセキュリティーセンター（ＮＣＳＣ）は先週、イラン政府とつながりのあるハッカーらが「チョーズン・ブリック」と呼ばれるスパイウエアを使い、電子メールやメッセージ、その他の機密情報を盗み出していたと発表した。ワッツアップやテレグラムなどのメッセージアプリを通じ、特定の相手を狙う「スピアフィッシング（標的型メール）」攻撃を仕掛けていたという。

英外務省はロイターのコメント要請に直ちに回答しなかった。

items.title: Insurance Australia Group settles $2 billion Credit Suisse lawsuit over Greensill collapse
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Insurance Australia Group said on Friday its unit had agreed to settle a A$2.8 billion ($1.96 billion) Credit Suisse lawsuit over losses linked to finance firm Greensill Capital.
items.body:
Insurance Australia Group (IAG.AX) said on Friday its unit had agreed to settle a A$2.8 billion ($1.96 billion) Credit Suisse lawsuit over losses linked to finance firm Greensill Capital.
Here are some key details:
The insurer did not disclose the terms of the settlement citing confidentiality.
The aggregate face value of the claimed amounts in the Credit Suisse Proceedings was about A$2.8 billion plus interest, Insurance Australia said.
The proceedings relate to policies issued by Insurance Australia's unit BCC Trade Credit to Greensill entities.
The settlement comes just months after Insurance Australia agreed to settle a A$4 billion lawsuit by the administrators of Greensill Bank.
The 2021 collapse of Greensill Capital led Credit Suisse to wind down $10 billion in funds linked to the firm.
Last year, Credit Suisse had [USN:L5N3VW0J0 TEXT:"lost"] a $440 million lawsuit against SoftBank Group Corp (9984.T) over funds Greensill had lent to Katerra, a construction company backed by the Japanese group.
UBS Group, which took over Credit Suisse after its 2023 collapse, did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Insurance Australia said the remaining proceedings brought by White Oak against its unit Insurance Australia Limited remain ongoing, with the aggregate face value of claim amounts at nearly A$170 million.
The insurer said the Credit Suisse settlement would not have a material impact on its 2027 financial results.
($1 = 1.4261 Australian dollars)

items.title: Reino Unido adverte Irã de que não tolerará atividades hostis em solo britânico, segundo reportagem da Sky News
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O ministro das Relações Exteriores britânico, Ed Miliband, disse ao ministro das Relações Exteriores iraniano, Abbas Araqchi, durante uma reunião, que o Reino Unido “não tolerará intimidações, ameaças ou atividades hostis em solo britânico” por parte de grupos ligados ao país dele, informou a Sky News nesta quinta-feira.
items.body:
O ministro das Relações Exteriores britânico, Ed Miliband, disse ao ministro das Relações Exteriores iraniano, Abbas Araqchi, durante uma reunião, que o Reino Unido “não tolerará intimidações, ameaças ou atividades hostis em solo britânico” por parte de grupos ligados ao país dele, informou a Sky News nesta quinta-feira.
Miliband e Araqchi se encontraram à margem da Assembleia Geral das Nações Unidas, em Nova York, segundo a reportagem, citando o Ministério das Relações Exteriores britânico.
Os dois discutiram a guerra no Oriente Médio, a importância da reabertura do Estreito de Ormuz e a “determinação inabalável do Reino Unido de combater ameaças de grupos ligados ao Irã em solo britânico”, acrescentou a reportagem.
O Centro Nacional de Segurança Cibernética do Reino Unido informou na semana passada que agentes cibernéticos ligados ao Estado iraniano haviam usado uma família de spywares conhecida como “CHOSEN BRICK” para roubar emails, mensagens e outras informações confidenciais por meio de campanhas de “spear-phishing” em plataformas de mensagens, incluindo WhatsApp e Telegram.
O Ministério das Relações Exteriores, da Comunidade Britânica e do Desenvolvimento do Reino Unido não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário da Reuters.

By Patricia Zengerle
WASHINGTON, Sept 24 (Reuters) – US Senate Democrats criticized President Donald Trump’s summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday, saying it prioritized pageantry over substance on issues such as artificial intelligence, trade, critical minerals and weapons for Taiwan.

Trump welcomed Xi to the White House for a state summit heavy on diplomatic honors, but with no sign that closed-door talks yielded breakthroughs on the issues dividing them.  

In a statement signed by at least 19 of the 47 members of the Democratic caucus and seen by Reuters, the Democrats called on Trump to immediately deliver more than $15 billion in security assistance  —  $1.3 billion in funds and a $14 billion arms sale package  —  that Congress has approved for Taiwan and to push for human rights and the release of wrongfully detained Americans.

Show Full Article

Some of Trump’s fellow Republicans also marked the summit by calling on Trump to release the funds for Taiwan.

The Democrats also criticized Trump’s loosening of restrictions on high-end chip sales to China, and said that the extension of the US-China tariff truce does not sufficiently address supply chain issues such as China’s hold on global rare earth refining.

“We will compete successfully with China only through sustained investment in our own strengths, close coordination with allies, and an unwavering defense of our democratic values,” the statement said.

Democrats are typically critical of Trump’s policies, but their response to the summit gave an indication of how party members might address Beijing if they take control of one or both houses of Congress in the November 3 midterm elections.

Polls show that Trump’s Republicans will struggle to keep their slim majorities in Congress in the upcoming contest, as the president’s approval rating drops. 

(Reporting by Patricia Zengerle; editing by Don Durfee and Sanjeev Miglani)

items.title: US edge International team in tight Presidents Cup opener
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The United States began their bid for an 11th consecutive Presidents Cup title with a 3-2 lead over the International Team after Thursday's opening fourball session at Medinah Country Club outside Chicago.
items.body:
The United States began their bid for an 11th consecutive Presidents Cup title with a 3-2 lead over the International Team after Thursday's opening fourball session at Medinah Country Club outside Chicago.
Justin Thomas and 21-year-old rookie Jackson Koivun put the first point on the board for the Americans with a 4&3 victory over Corey Conners and Nico Echavarria.
Koivun made two early birdies as the Americans took control, and they never trailed before the Internationals conceded the 15th. The victory extended Thomas' unbeaten record in Presidents Cup fourballs to 7-0-0.
"It was fun to be out there with Jackson and watch him do his thing. He's really impressive to watch, and I'm really happy he's on my team," Thomas said.
The Internationals quickly answered through Hideki Matsuyama and Ryo Hisatsune, who beat Cameron Young and Xander Schauffele 3&1 to level the session at 1-1.
The Japanese pair moved two up after nine holes and held off a late challenge from the Americans, with Hisatsune answering Young's birdie at the 15th before the Internationals closed out the match.
"I'm just lucky," Hisatsune said. "Playing with Hideki, he's also a friend, so (he) gives me more trust every single time."
SCHEFFLER, BURNS HOLD ON Scottie Scheffler and Sam Burns restored the US lead with a 1-up victory over Min Woo Lee and Sungjae Im, finally earning a Presidents Cup win together after struggling to convert previous opportunities.
The Americans raced into an early four-hole lead but saw it disappear, and Im moved the Internationals ahead at the 13th. Burns immediately responded with a birdie at the next hole, hitting an eight-iron to a couple of feet.
"It was kind of a key moment in our match just to kind of snatch back some of that momentum," Burns said.
Scheffler then produced the shot of the match at the last, recovering from a bunker to within tap-in range and leaving Im needing a long birdie putt to keep the match alive. Im missed, allowing the world number one and Burns to close out the win.
"I felt like, if I could make a nice bunker shot in there, it would really put a lot of pressure on him in order to have to make his putt in order to tie the match," world number one Scheffler said.
"It was probably just a little bit of a sigh of relief to finally get a point and just kind of let that out," Burns said.
Wyndham Clark and Collin Morikawa then extended the US advantage with a dominant 3&2 victory over Adam Scott and Ryan Fox, giving the Americans a two-point cushion heading into the final match.
The US pair led from the opening hole and maintained their advantage despite failing to capitalize on several chances in the middle of the round.
Tom Kim and Si Woo Kim cut the deficit to 3-2 with a 3&2 win over Chris Gotterup and Patrick Cantlay in the final match.
The South Koreans moved two up early, were pegged back to all square and then regained control before closing out the match at the 16th.
"We did a really good job of just managing momentum and really choosing the holes to attack," Tom Kim said. "It helps when your partner makes a lot of birdies."
Tom Kim's tee shot on the 16th nearly produced an ace, hitting the flagstick before spinning away, but the Internationals had already secured the match.
The biennial team event features 30 matches over four days, with the first team to reach 15.5 points winning the Presidents Cup. Friday's schedule features five foursomes matches, with fourballs and foursomes sessions to follow on Saturday before Sunday's 12 singles.
The US have won the Presidents Cup 13 times, lost once and tied once, with their only defeat coming in 1998 and the lone tie in 2003.

[２４日 ロイター] - 米アカマイ・テクノロジーズは２４日、人工知能（ＡＩ）開発企業アンソロピックと総額１１６億ドルのクラウドサービス契約を締結した。アンソロピックにアカマイ株の最大５％を取得できるワラント（新株予約権）を付与する内容も含まれ、アカマイの株価は時間外取引で２２％急騰した。

今回の契約により、急成長するＡＩ企業の１社から長期的な確約を得た。アカマイが今年発表した複数年のクラウドインフラ契約は顧客全体で２８億ドルを超えており、今回の契約によってさらに増加する。

契約期間は７年間。アンソロピックはワラントにより、シリーズＢ株を１株当たり１１１．３３ドルで購入する権利を得る。これはアカマイの普通株式約７７０万株に転換される。

新規株式公開（ＩＰＯ）を計画するアンソロピックは、計算能力の拡大と、より高性能なモデルの訓練・運用に必要なインフラの確保を積極的に進めており、クラウド事業者やデータセンター事業者との間で数十億ドル規模の契約を相次いで結んでいる。

イーマーケターのアナリスト、ジェイコブ・ボーン氏は「自律型ＡＩの潜在的な悪影響を巡る懸念が高まっているものの、計算負荷の高まる自律型ＡＩの処理を支えるため、インフラ投資は今後も拡大し続けるだろう」と指摘。株式取得の可能性については「ＡＩ主導のクラウド需要の持続性に対する信任投票と見なせる」と述べた。

ワラントのうち、アカマイの発行済み普通株式の約２％に相当する部分は、アンソロピックによる１１６億ドルのコミットメントに連動する。残る３％は、両社が契約規模をさらに最大９０億ドル拡大した場合に権利が確定する。

アカマイによると、当初のコミットメントに関連する設備投資総額は約５５億ドルと見込まれる。

items.title: トランプ氏のＩＣＣ脱退呼びかけ、呼応はナウルだけ　欧州など反発
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Simon Lewis

[国連 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
Simon Lewis

[国連 ２４日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日の国連における一般討論演説で、各国に対し国際刑事裁判所（ＩＣＣ）から直ちに脱退するよう求め、ＩＣＣを「邪悪」で「ならず者の機関」だと非難した。ただ今週の国連総会で脱退の意向を示したのは、今のところ太平洋の小さな島国のナウルだけだ。

トランプ氏の訴えは、オランダ・ハーグに本部を置くＩＣＣに対する米政府の圧力強化の一環。米政府は、ＩＣＣの設立条約である「ローマ規程」を批准していない米国やイスラエルの国民にも管轄権を行使しようとしているとして、ＩＣＣが権限を逸脱していると主張している。

ローマ規程の締約国は１２５カ国。欧州を中心とする多くの国は、国際司法の柱としてＩＣＣを擁護する立場を維持する。

一方米国はＩＣＣ職員に金融制裁や査証（ビザ）発給制限を科しており、事情に詳しい関係者によると、ＩＣＣの活動能力を損なう可能性がある追加制裁も準備している。

ルビオ米国務長官は７月、ＩＣＣを「必要なら１つ１つ解体する」として外交攻勢を開始した。米軍関係者のほか、トランプ政権による移民の強制送還や、麻薬密輸船とされる船舶への攻撃に関与する米国人に、ＩＣＣが脅威をもたらしているというのが理由だ。

トランプ氏は、ＩＣＣが２０２４年、パレスチナ自治区ガザでの戦闘を巡りイスラエルのネタニヤフ首相と当時の国防相、イスラム組織ハマスの軍事部門幹部に逮捕状を出したことを踏まえ、一連の対ＩＣＣ措置はネタニヤフ氏を守ることが目的だとしている。

ＩＣＣを巡っては、既にベネズエラとチャドが脱退方針を表明。ブルキナファソ、マリ、ニジェールは昨年脱退を発表した。

ナウルのアデアン大統領は２２日の国連総会で演説し、ＩＣＣは「ますます存在意義を失っている」として、ローマ規程から正式に脱退する考えを示した。

デソンブル米国務次官補（東アジア・太平洋担当）はナウルの外務副大臣との会談後、Ｘへの投稿で「ナウルは、ＩＣＣによる不当な権限逸脱に対して自国の主権を守ろうと立ち上がる国々の仲間入りをした」と歓迎した。

これに対して欧州連合（ＥＵ）はＩＣＣを擁護する姿勢を鮮明にしており、米国が追加制裁に踏み切った場合に対抗するため「ブロッキング規則」の策定について協議している。

ＥＵのカラス外交安全保障上級代表は今週、記者団に「事態が本当に深刻になった場合、ＩＣＣをどのように守るかについて、われわれには使える手段がある」と述べた。その上で、国連総会の場でＩＣＣの機能や責任追及の取り組みを支持する国々の結集を図っていると説明。「これは欧州だけの問題ではなく、はるかに幅広い問題だ」と語った。

ＩＣＣの赤根智子所長が米国の制裁対象とされている点から、日本政府はこの制裁案について「極めて遺憾」とし、赤根氏への支援策を協議するため当局者をハーグに派遣した。高市早苗首相も２２日の国連総会でＩＣＣを支持する日本の立場を表明した。

国際危機グループの上級顧問ブライアン・フィヌケーン氏は、多くの国が責任追及というＩＣＣの使命を引き続き重視しており、米国によるＩＣＣへの攻勢の影響は限定的だと指摘した。

フィヌケーン氏は、ＩＣＣがロシアのプーチン大統領に逮捕状を出した後、プーチン氏もＩＣＣを標的にしたと説明。「トランプ政権はＩＣＣ職員に制裁を科すという点でプーチン氏と足並みをそろえる形になった。もちろんＩＣＣが解体されればプーチン氏も利益を得る」と述べた。

items.title: Trump, US House speaker and tech CEOs to meet on AI on September 29, source says
items.author: Courtney Rozen, Kanishka Singh
items.creator: Courtney Rozen, Kanishka Singh
items.summary: US President Donald Trump, Republican House of Representatives Speaker Mike Johnson and tech CEOs will hold a meeting on artificial intelligence on September 29, a source familiar with the planned meeting said late on Thursday.
items.body:
US President Donald Trump , Republican House of Representatives Speaker Mike Johnson and tech CEOs will hold a meeting on artificial intelligence on September 29, a source familiar with the planned meeting said late on Thursday.
The world's leading artificial intelligence companies have warned of the risks posed by AI to humanity, appealing for governments to work together to manage the increasingly powerful technology.
Governments around the world have struggled to keep pace with rapid advances in AI.
The planned meeting was reported earlier by Axios. Further details were not immediately available.
The United States and China, the two leading powers in AI development, have taken different approaches to oversight.
Trump has argued the US does not need new AI-specific regulations, while China has imposed rules governing AI algorithms and training data, including requirements that AI-generated content be clearly labeled.
Trump told world leaders at the UN General Assembly on Tuesday he "rejects any attempt to construct a globalist scheme to control" AI, describing the technology as amazing but noting the US would be careful.

items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: ［名古屋　２４日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
［名古屋　２４日　ロイター］ - 愛知・名古屋アジア大会は２４日、競泳男子２００メートル平泳ぎの決勝を行い、１７歳の大橋信が２分４秒８３の世界新記録をマークし、１００メートルとの２冠を達成した。

第４レーンからスタートした大橋は、前半の１００メートルをトップの５９秒８９で通過。そのまま首位を譲らず、覃海洋（中国）が２０２３年７月に樹立した世界記録を０秒６５更新した。

大橋は東京アクアティクスセンターでのレース後、「世界記録を目標にしていたので、達成できてとてもうれしい。次の目標は世界選手権での金メダル」と語った。

第５レーンからスタートした渡辺一平は２分９秒５０で５位だった。

女子２００メートル平泳ぎの決勝では、加藤心冨が２分２２秒５７で金メダル。鈴木聡美は４位でメダルを逃した。

items.title: Presidente iraniano diz que cabe aos EUA decidir se querem pôr fim à guerra com o Irã
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O presidente iraniano, Masoud Pezeshkian, afirmou que cabe aos Estados Unidos decidir quando a guerra com o Irã chegará ao fim, ao ser questionado se o conflito poderia terminar até o final do ano.
items.body:
O presidente iraniano, Masoud Pezeshkian, afirmou que cabe aos Estados Unidos decidir quando a guerra com o Irã chegará ao fim, ao ser questionado se o conflito poderia terminar até o final do ano.
“Mas não queremos continuar. São os Estados Unidos que precisam decidir se querem encerrar isso ou não”, disse Pezeshkian, respondendo à pergunta em uma entrevista exibida nesta quinta-feira no programa “Special Report with Bret Baier”, da Fox News.
O presidente do Irã disse à Assembleia Geral da ONU na quarta-feira que Teerã nunca se renderia à pressão dos EUA, já que os dois lados continuam com posições muito distantes sobre como encerrar a guerra.
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, disse na terça-feira que poderia “aniquilar” o Irã caso não haja um acordo para encerrar a guerra, mas também sugeriu que um acordo poderia ser alcançado em breve.
Trump tem apresentado metas e prazos variáveis para a guerra que começou em 28 de fevereiro, quando os EUA e Israel atacaram o Irã e Teerã respondeu com seus próprios ataques contra Israel e países do Golfo que abrigam bases norte-americanas.
Os ataques dos EUA e de Israel ao Irã e os ataques israelenses ao Líbano mataram milhares de pessoas e deslocaram milhões.
Trump citou o enfraquecimento das capacidades nucleares do Irã como um de seus objetivos de guerra.
O Irã, que não possui armas nucleares, nega estar buscando obtê-las.
Teerã afirma ter o direito de desenvolver tecnologia nuclear para fins pacíficos, como signatário do Tratado de Não Proliferação Nuclear (TNP).

items.title: US Democrats criticize lavish Trump-Xi summit as lacking substance
items.author: Patricia Zengerle
items.creator: Patricia Zengerle
items.summary: US Senate Democrats criticized President Donald Trump's summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday, saying it prioritized pageantry over substance on issues such as artificial intelligence, trade, critical minerals and weapons for Taiwan.
items.body:
US Senate Democrats criticized President Donald Trump's summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping on Thursday, saying it prioritized pageantry over substance on issues such as artificial intelligence, trade, critical minerals and weapons for Taiwan.
Trump welcomed Xi to the White House for a [USN:L1N45F0US TEXT:"state summit"] heavy on diplomatic honors, but with no sign that closed-door talks yielded breakthroughs on the issues dividing them.
In a statement signed by at least 19 of the 47 members of the Democratic caucus and seen by Reuters, the Democrats called on Trump to immediately deliver more than $15 billion in security assistance — $1.3 billion in funds and a $14 billion arms sale package — that Congress has approved for Taiwan and to push for human rights and the release of wrongfully detained Americans.
Some of Trump's fellow Republicans also marked the summit by [USN:L1N45F0LQ TEXT:"calling on Trump"] to release the funds for Taiwan.
The Democrats also criticized Trump's loosening of restrictions on high-end chip sales to China, and said that the extension of the US-China tariff truce does not sufficiently address supply chain issues such as China's hold on global rare earth refining.
"We will compete successfully with China only through sustained investment in our own strengths, close coordination with allies, and an unwavering defense of our democratic values," the statement said.
Democrats are typically critical of Trump's policies, but their response to the summit gave an indication of how party members might address Beijing if they take control of one or both houses of Congress in the November 3 midterm elections.
Polls show that Trump's Republicans will struggle to keep their slim majorities in Congress in the upcoming contest, as the president's approval rating drops.

items.title: 日本市場、米債売り加速で金利一段高へ－円は軟調公算・AI株上値重い
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 　　25日の日本市場では、原油高や財政懸念を背景に米国債売りが加速したことを受け、国債利回りが一段と上昇しそう。金利のボラティリティーの高さから投資家のリスクセンチメントが悪化し、株式はAI関連を中心に上値の重い展開が予想される。為替は米金利高を手がかりとしたドル買いが優勢で、円は160円の節目に向けて軟調に推移しそうだ。

米国とイランの交渉担当者はホルムズ海峡の再開に向けて段階的な合意を模索しているものの、通航再開に対する懐疑的な見方は根強く、24日の原油先物相場は急伸した。原油価格の高止まりによるインフレ懸念が利上げ観測を高め、世界的な債券売りが広がっている。

米30年債利回りは一時2004年以来の高水準となり、日本でも債券売りが強まりそうだ。金融引き締めへの観測に加え、日本の財政懸念も引き続き重しとなる。きょうは残存期間5年超11年以下を対象とした流動性供給入札が実施される。

金利の大幅変動が投資家のリスク選好に逆風となり、株式市場で積極的な取引は控えられやすい。米フィラデルフィア半導体株指数（SOX）が下落しており、国内でも前日に買われたAI・半導体関連株を中心に売りが先行しそうだ。

為替はドルが強含む中、円は24日に一時159円04銭と2日以来の安値に下げた。160円の節目が意識される半面、160円に接近すれば当局による介入への警戒が一段と高まるとみられ、一方的な円売りには歯止めがかかる可能性が高い。

（注：表中の終値は米国時間終値。円相場は対米ドル、前営業日比は円の対ドル変化率。米10年金利の前営業日比は変化幅（単位：%ポイント）。日経平均の前営業日比はシカゴ・マーカンタイル取引所清算値と大阪取引所清算値との比較。シカゴ取引所が休場の場合は大阪取引所の夜間終値と通常取引清算値の比較。金は1トロイオンス当たりのドル建て価格）

items.title: Tesla set to formally roll out Semi electric trucks at Nevada event
items.author: Abhirup Roy
items.creator: Abhirup Roy
items.summary: Tesla is set to roll out its Semi trucks late on Thursday at an inauguration of its plant in Sparks, Nevada, the EV maker said on its website and social media, almost nine years after CEO Elon Musk unveiled the electric big rigs.
items.body:
Tesla (TSLA.O) is set to roll out its Semi trucks late on Thursday at an inauguration of its plant in Sparks, Nevada, the EV maker said on its website and social media, almost nine years after CEO Elon Musk unveiled the electric big rigs.
The Semi, designed for long-haul freight with a range of up to 500 miles, was first unveiled in 2017 and production was expected to start in 2019.
The first truck eventually rolled off the high-volume production line in April and volume production was set to start this year. However, Tesla's July shareholder letter said that production of Semi would begin in 2026, removing an earlier forecast for volume production this year.
The Semi expands the market for Tesla, known for its electric sedans and SUVs, into commercial freight haulers at a time when diesel prices in the United States have soared to record highs.
Tesla began limited deliveries to customers including PepsiCo in the US in late 2022. Delays, rising competition and reversal in EV policies in the United States have since raised concerns about demand.
Still, Tesla this week received an order for 2,500 Semis from a coalition of the world's largest cargo-owning shippers, including Microsoft and PepsiCo, according to clean transportation nonprofit Catalyst Mobility. That is nearly double the existing US fleet of electric Class 8 trucks, the nonprofit said.
Last month, Swedish freight technology company Einride AB announced a deal to add 500 Semi trucks to its fleet.
Tesla had said the Nevada factory was being set up to run at an annual capacity of up to 50,000 units. Tesla investors and fans online have said they expect details on how Tesla plans to ramp up production of Semis, prices, and names of major customers.
items.raw_description: Tesla is set to roll out its Semi trucks late on Thursday at an inauguration of its plant in Sparks, Nevada, the EV maker said on its website and social media, almost nine years after CEO Elon Musk unveiled the electric big rigs.

items.title: Beyond high-profile wars, a worldwide battle for resources
items.author: Peter Apps
items.creator: Peter Apps
items.summary: According to Pakistani media, the militants who stormed a lithium mining site in Balochistan last month had a simple message as they destroyed equipment and briefly detained employees: they were no longer prepared to tolerate mining operations in the region, and foreign and local mining firms should stay away.
items.body:
According to Pakistani media, the militants who stormed a lithium mining site in Balochistan last month had a simple message as they destroyed equipment and briefly detained employees: they were no longer prepared to tolerate mining operations in the region, and foreign and local mining firms should stay away.
As wars in the Middle East and Ukraine grabbed headlines and the United States and China navigated their still largely bloodless face-off, culminating in the meeting of President Donald Trump and Xi Jinping this week, a host of other overlapping confrontations over resources have ranged elsewhere in the world throughout 2026.
Behind the scenes, the US, European Union and Pacific governments, particularly Japan, South Korea, Australia and Taiwan, are already locked in a still-escalating high-stakes race to uncouple themselves from China when it comes to the key resources driving modern tech.
Rare earths and minerals continue to fuel conflict in central Africa, while Sudan’s ongoing civil war is now largely fuelled by gold smuggling that fills the coffers of groups intent on ethnic violence.
Some of that will have been discussed in New York this week at the annual United Nations General Assembly bringing world leaders together – but much of this global confrontation now takes place behind the scenes, albeit with starkly rising stakes.
In the Gulf, the US-Iran conflict sparked by the launch of the US-Israeli "Operation Epic Fury" – now widened to include a worsening face-off between Saudi Arabia and Iran-backed Houthi rebels – now threatens an energy supply shock that might significantly derail global growth.
In the short term, significant amounts of the energy of the UN gathering were consumed by discussions over the safety of fast-evolving artificial intelligence models, with OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman and others briefing the Security Council. Discussions over Ukraine have also included a potential suspension by both sides of attacks on energy infrastructure.
In the background, however, the at least equally high-stakes confrontation taking place is over the raw materials necessary for that ongoing computing and wider technological revolution – including copper for almost every form of circuitry, lithium batteries and a host of other rarer earths and other minerals.
In June, the European Commission joined the US State Department-coordinated “Pax Silica”, a Washington-led collective of more than two dozen nations that commenced with an agreement between the US and Japan in September and has expanded since to include much of Europe, as well as key Pacific allies.
Still, according to consultancy AlixPartners, Beijing still accounts for up to 70% of rare earth mining, 85% of refining capability and 90% of rare earth metal alloy and magnet production. According to industry experts, the latter remains a pinch point for both aerospace and cutting-edge chip manufacturers – and so far, foreign diplomats in Washington say the US continues to struggle to regain that initiative.
That makes the battle for resources in places like Pakistan and central Asia particularly important – even while the limits of reporting and established fact can make that hard to track. What is clear, however, is that they are already very much part of that wider confrontation.
BALOCHISTAN MINING TARGETED According to global monitoring NGO ACLED – which stands for Armed Conflict Location and Event Data – mining interests in Balochistan have been targeted on at least 40 separate occasions so far in 2026.
Local media now detail a wider range of incidents taking place almost every day, including an ambush and firefight of almost three dozen mining vehicles at the end of August that left at least 13 militants dead.
Other stories tell of suspected militants detained and then found dead, victims of suspected extrajudicial killings by government personnel or private security.
Who is behind the several overlapping groups of ethnic Baloch militants remains hotly disputed. Pakistan routinely blames India’s Research and Analysis Wing intelligence agency, known as RAW, for coordinating and arming the attacks, something India denies. The region is the poorest in Pakistan, with guerrilla fighters reportedly crossing the border from Iran and Afghanistan.
What is not in doubt is their mounting opposition to Chinese mining interests, which has intensified sharply in recent years. The US has condemned the attacks as terrorism, but not commented in more detail – although the government in Islamabad has increasingly presented itself to the Trump administration as an appealing partner, including as a source of resources.
Visiting Trump in the Oval Office in October 2025, Pakistan's military chief and de facto ruler Asim Munir brought with him a wooden display case of minerals before signing a $500 million memorandum of understanding. While mining currently makes up less than 1% of Pakistani GDP, the government claims it has as much as $6 trillion in undeveloped reserves.
Amongst the largest projects is the Reko Dik gold and copper mine, unusually for Pakistan one by Canadian firm Barrick rather than a China-based conglomerate. The multi-vehicle convoy ambushed at the end of August was returning from the mine, due to enter production in 2029.
OTHER RESOURCE FLASHPOINTS Other nations increasingly in the crosshairs of global resource competition include those in Central Asia. In June, Kazakhstan became the first nation in that region to sign up to the US-run “Pax Silica” – but it appeared to alienate Washington by also joining the China-run World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organisation (WAICO) barely three weeks later.
That prompted an immediate warning from the US State Department that membership of the “Pax Silica” collective was irreconcilable with joining rival Chinese entities. But in reality, Washington will always seek to continue to build new resource deals with the Kazakhstan government, which oversees some of the world’s largest stockpiles of uranium as well as chromite, copper, beryllium, tantalum, lead and zinc.
The US hosted all five major Central Asian powers at a critical mineral summit last November, striking further deals with Uzbekistan and Tajikistan. South Korea hosted its own critical mineral summit this month with several Central Asian governments, while Japanese media reported this week that Tokyo would launch its own strategy next year with a similar goal.
Japan is also now at the forefront of what is now often described as “urban mining”.
In April, a quartet of Japanese companies announced they would use robots to recover neodymium magnets critical to computer hard drives from old air-conditioners. Other firms are pushing ahead with undersea remote mining projects to tap resources previously unreachable.
The Trump administration also has a range of commercial and diplomatic outreach underway in Latin America, keen to push back against the previous dominance of Chinese extractive firms in the “Lithium Triangle” of Chile, Argentina and Bolivia – although despite that, Chinese trade with South American nations has continued to rise sharply in the current year.
In the Oval Office this week, Trump and Xi might have tried to look like two geopolitical titans dividing the world between them. But the reality on the ground is already considerably messier, and the scramble for resources in the new industrial age is only just beginning.

items.title: KKR-backed e-bus maker PMI Electro confidentially files for India IPO
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: KKR-backed electric bus maker PMI Electro Mobility Solutions has confidentially filed draft papers for an initial public offering in Mumbai, a newspaper advertisement showed on Friday.
items.body:
KKR-backed (KKR.N) electric bus maker PMI Electro Mobility Solutions has confidentially filed draft papers for an initial public offering in Mumbai, a newspaper advertisement showed on Friday.
Founded in 2017, PMI Electro Mobility is an electric commercial vehicle manufacturer with a fleet of 3,300 e-buses across 34 cities in India.
US private equity firm KKR had earlier this year [USN:L4N4060KQ TEXT:"invested"] around $310 million in PMI Electro Mobility Solutions and its e-bus platform Allfleet India.
PMI Electro competes with listed rivals Olectra Greentech (OLEC.NS) JBM Auto (JBMA.NS) and Tata Motors (TATM.NS) in India.
Under India's confidential filing process, companies can submit draft IPO documents to the market regulator without making them public, allowing them to shield sensitive financial and business information while seeking regulatory feedback.
(This story has been refiled to correct the dateline to Sept 25.)

items.title: UK consumer confidence hits more than two-year high in September, GfK says
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British consumer confidence unexpectedly struck a more than two-year high this month as households grew more optimistic about their personal finances, according to a survey on Friday that added to recent signs of resilience in the economy.
items.body:
British consumer confidence unexpectedly struck a more than two-year high this month as households grew more optimistic about their personal finances, according to a survey on Friday that added to recent signs of resilience in the economy.
Market research firm GfK's Consumer Confidence Barometer rose to -13 in September, up one point from last month and marking its highest level since August 2024, shortly after the governing Labour Party came to power.
A Reuters poll of economists had pointed to a fall to -16.
• GfK said consumers' confidence in the economic outlook also rose to its highest level since August 2024, while the mood around personal finances hit an eight-month high
• Neil Bellamy, consumer insights director at GfK, said the deteriorating inflation outlook could start to weigh on households
• "While the headline score continues to improve, confidence is still firmly in negative territory. With inflation, energy and fuel prices rising, could we soon see consumer sentiment falter?" he said
• Separate consumer confidence readings from YouGov/Cebr and LSEG/Ipsos published this month hit their highest readings since February
• Surveys from BRC/Opinium and S&P Global have shown a fall in consumer confidence
items.raw_description: British consumer confidence unexpectedly struck a more than two-year high this month as households grew more optimistic about their personal finances, according to a survey on Friday that added to recent signs of resilience in the economy.

items.title: UK regulatory crackdown closes CFD firms with overseas links
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Britain's Financial Conduct Authority said on Friday that 21 firms offering CFDs had closed since 2025, three others were cancelling their regulatory permissions to trade and two face investigation after a crackdown on misleading customers.
items.body:
Britain's Financial Conduct Authority said on Friday that 21 firms offering CFDs had closed since 2025, three others were cancelling their regulatory permissions to trade and two face investigation after a crackdown on misleading customers.
The regulator did not name the firms offering contracts-for-differences, which are complex financial products used to bet on the price of a wide range of assets without owning them. The FCA has been [USN:L6N3WP0MG TEXT:"cracking down"] on CFD providers since it restricted their sale to retail customers in 2019.
It said CFD firms that do little business in Britain, but use their authorisation to lend credibility to linked overseas businesses, led people to think they were dealing directly with a UK-regulated firm and would benefit from UK protections.
"Consumers need to know exactly who they're dealing with and what protections they have," Dominic Holland, the FCA's director of sell-side supervision, said in a statement.
"When firms blur the lines between their UK-regulated activities and overseas businesses, we will step in," he added.
Retail customers who trade CFDs through FCA-authorised firms can access the Financial Ombudsman Service to raise complaints, receive potential compensation in the event of firm failures, have limits placed on leverage and a range of other protections.

items.title: Yankees, Orioles move up Saturday game into Friday twin bill
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Baltimore Orioles and host New York Yankees won't play Saturday due to inclement weather anticipated to hit the Northeast.
items.body:
The Baltimore Orioles and host New York Yankees won't play Saturday due to inclement weather anticipated to hit the Northeast.
Instead, the American League East rivals will play a single-admission doubleheader on Friday, with Game 1 slated for 4:05 p.m., three hours ahead of the original game time.
If Game 1 ends later than 6:35 p.m., then Game 2 will begin about 30 minutes later, not before 7:05.
The Yankees said tickets for Saturday's game will not be honored for the Friday doubleheader.
The Yankees (91-67) are locked into the first wild-card spot in the American League since the Tampa Bay Rays (96-62) clinched the East title with a win at Yankee Stadium on Tuesday. The Orioles (78-81) will miss the playoffs.
The Boston Red Sox have made similar arrangements for their regular-season-ending series against the visiting Chicago Cubs. Boston and Chicago will play a split doubleheader Friday and the third game of their series is slated for Saturday night; they will conclude the regular season one day before the rest of baseball, with the effects of a nor'easter expected to affect Boston on Sunday.
--Field Level Media

items.title: オラクル、データセンター開発で不可抗力通知　電力確保遅延も＝関係者
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -  米ＩＴ大手オラクル は西部ニューメキシコ州で進めている大型データセンター開発を巡り、電力確保が遅れる可能性があるとして、米資産運用会社ブルー・アウル
items.body:
Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -  米ＩＴ大手オラクル は西部ニューメキシコ州で進めている大型データセンター開発を巡り、電力確保が遅れる可能性があるとして、米資産運用会社ブルー・アウル の傘下企業に「不可抗力（フォース・マジュール）」を通知した。事情に詳しい関係者が２４日、ロイターに明らかにした。これを受けてオラクル株は３％超下落した。

関係者の話では、契約上はデータセンター用地の電力確保はオラクルの責任となっており、オラクルはいかなる場合も賃貸契約を解除できない。ブルー・アウルは同プロジェクトに約３０億ドルを出資し、オラクルは債務コストを負担する。

企業は通常、自らの制御が及ばない問題が発生した場合、契約上の義務を免れるため不可抗力条項を発動するが、こうした措置は金融機関や投資家の懸念を招きかねない。

ブルームバーグが先に報じたところによると、オラクルは主要テナントとして撤退するのではなく、「プロジェクト・ジュピター」と呼ばれるデータセンターが計画通り２０２８年に稼働できない場合に備え、支払い開始を遅らせようとしている。

オラクルはロイターのコメント要請に回答していない。これに先立ち同社は「プロジェクト・ジュピターは計画通りのスケジュールで進んでいる」と説明した。

データセンター開発会社スタック・インフラストラクチャーを傘下に持つブルー・アウルは、今回の通知によっても複数年にわたる同プロジェクトへの財務上のコミットメントに変更はないと述べた。

関係者は、ブルー・アウルが開発期間中に出資額に対して９％の利回りを得るとともに、完成後のレバレッジ後利回りは約１１％になる見通しだと言及した。

オラクルが不可抗力条項を発動したことで、ブルー・アウルに開発段階の低い賃料を支払う期間が延長される。ブルー・アウルは当初計画された期間分について、より高い完成後の賃料を引き続き受け取るが、その開始時期が後ずれするという。

Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

items.body:
オラクル、データセンター開発で不可抗力通知　電力確保遅延も＝関係者
8:01 配信

米ＩＴ大手オラクルのロゴ。2025年9月9日撮影。 REUTERS/Dado Ruvic/Illustration

Isla Binnie　Jaspreet Singh

[２４日 ロイター] -  米ＩＴ大手オラクル は西部ニューメキシコ州で進めている大型データセンター開発を巡り、電力確保が遅れる可能性があるとして、米資産運用会社ブルー・アウル の傘下企業に「不可抗力（フォース・マジュール）」を通知した。事情に詳しい関係者が２４日、ロイターに明らかにした。これを受けてオラクル株は３％超下落した。

関係者の話では、契約上はデータセンター用地の電力確保はオラクルの責任となっており、オラクルはいかなる場合も賃貸契約を解除できない。ブルー・アウルは同プロジェクトに約３０億ドルを出資し、オラクルは債務コストを負担する。

企業は通常、自らの制御が及ばない問題が発生した場合、契約上の義務を免れるため不可抗力条項を発動するが、こうした措置は金融機関や投資家の懸念を招きかねない。

ブルームバーグが先に報じたところによると、オラクルは主要テナントとして撤退するのではなく、「プロジェクト・ジュピター」と呼ばれるデータセンターが計画通り２０２８年に稼働できない場合に備え、支払い開始を遅らせようとしている。

items.title: Britain warns Iran it will not tolerate hostile activity on UK soil, Sky News reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in a meeting that Britain will "not tolerate intimidation, threats or hostile activity on UK soil" from groups linked to his country, Sky News reported on Thursday.
items.body:
British Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband told Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi in a meeting that Britain will "not tolerate intimidation, threats or hostile activity on UK soil" from groups linked to his country, Sky News reported on Thursday.
Miliband and Araqchi met on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, the report said, citing Britain's foreign office.
Miliband and Araqchi discussed the war in the Middle East , the importance of reopening the Strait of Hormuz and Britain's "unwavering resolve to combat threats from Iranian-linked groups in UK soil", the report added.
Britain's National Cyber Security Centre said last week Iranian state-linked [USN:S8N41P0E1 TEXT:"cyber"] actors had used a spyware family known as "CHOSEN BRICK" to steal emails, messages and other sensitive information through "spear-phishing" campaigns on messaging platforms including WhatsApp and Telegram.
The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.

items.title: メキシコ中銀、政策金利6.5％に維持　「据え置き継続」示唆する文言削除
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [メキシコ市 ２４日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[メキシコ市 ２４日 ロイター] - メキシコ銀行（中央銀行）は２４日、市場の予想通り政策金利を６．５０％に据え置いた。ただ、今後も借り入れコストを現行水準に維持すると示唆していたフォワードガイダンス（先行き指針）の文言は削除した。

決定は５人の理事の全会一致だった。中銀は声明で、今後の政策決定に当たっては、進行中のディスインフレの過程と、為替相場の消費者物価への波及、経済のスラック（需給の緩み）の状況、インフレ期待など、判断材料の動向を考慮すると表明。

過去３回の声明では、現行の金利水準を今後も維持することが適切との見解を示していたが、今回はこの文言が削除された。

中銀は、総合インフレ率が２０２７年第４・四半期に目標の３％に収束するとの見通しを維持し、インフレのリスクバランスは引き続き上振れに傾いているとの認識を示した。

また、米国の経済政策や地政学的紛争に起因する不確実性を指摘。一方、予測期間を通じて経済のスラックが継続すると見込まれるほか、経済活動には依然として大きな下振れリスクがあるとした。

米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が今月利上げを決定したことについては、メキシコの金融政策がＦＲＢの動きに自動的に追随する必要はないとした。

items.title: OpenAI to preview GPT-6 Cyber within days, Fortune reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OpenAI is set to preview a cybersecurity-focused AI model, GPT-6 Cyber, within days and launch a new product designed to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically, Fortune reported on Thursday, citing multiple sources familiar with the plans.
items.body:
OpenAI is set to preview a cybersecurity-focused AI model, GPT-6 Cyber, within days and launch a new product designed to help customers deploy it more securely and automatically, Fortune reported on Thursday, citing multiple sources familiar with the plans.
OpenAI did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment outside regular business hours.
OpenAI Chief Executive Sam Altman and rival Anthropic's CEO earlier this month joined [USN:L4N456128 TEXT:"industry leaders"] in calling for a slower pace of AI development and stronger safety measures.
Cybersecurity is emerging as one of AI's fastest-growing markets, as tech firms develop tools to combat threats and contain rogue AI agents.
OpenAI has warned its flagship [USN:L4N45E133 TEXT:"Astra model"] from the GPT-6 lineup can at times try to evade human oversight, while [USN:L4N45F1EW TEXT:"Australia"] said on Thursday an OpenAI agent breached a government health data portal in June.
Fortune said GPT-6 Cyber, OpenAI's fourth cybersecurity-focused model released this year, could be unveiled at the company's DevDay event in San Francisco on Tuesday, along with plans to ship a dozen or more other products.
A limited group of customers in OpenAI's application-only Daybreak Red cybersecurity program already has access to GPT-6 Cyber for alpha testing, the report said.

FAST

NEW YORK, Sept 24 : Oracle's move to protect itself against potential delays at a massive data center project developed by Blue Owl in New Mexico sent a chill through the trillion-dollar market for AI infrastructure financing, according to interviews with bankers and investors.
Oracle issued a force majeure notice in connection with Jupiter, a data center campus Blue Owl unit STACK Infrastructure is building to support OpenAI, the latest setback for a sector where lenders and investors are growing more cautious about financing the industry's breakneck expansion.
Blue Owl said the notice did not alter the parties' commitment to the project. Even so, the event is reverberating through discussions around other proposed data center financings, including SB Energy, which is developing a campus to serve OpenAI in Ohio, a person close to its financing said. SB Energy decided this week to delay its IPO. 
Companies can use force majeure provisions when events beyond their control make it difficult to meet their contractual obligations. Lawyers say such provisions are becoming more common in data center development agreements, raising concerns among lenders and investors.
